; snip2tex toolbar: a ✦ button at the end of the document toolbar (next to the
; page overview / tags / menu buttons) that opens a small menu to pick the model
; the Mac uses (the local model or a Claude model) and switch thinking on/off.
; The menu talks to the Mac through model.sh (USB, or Wi-Fi mode), which saves
; the Mac's JSON reply to a file this polls. Kept apart from snip2tex.qmd so it
; can be removed on its own. Icon: qrc:/snip2tex/sparkle.svg from snip2tex.rcc.
; Needs: qt-command-executor. Written against firmware 3.27.3.0.

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0
    IMPORT xofm.libs.ghostbuster 1.0
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root > Item#toolbar > GridLayout#toolLayout
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.ToolButton {
                id: snip2texModelButton
                objectName: "snip2tex-model-button"
                iconSource: "qrc:/snip2tex/sparkle.svg"
                focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                visible: root.expanded
                background: Item {}
                onClicked: snip2texModelMenu.toggle(snip2texModelButton)

                PenInputBlocker {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    enabled: true
                    manager: root.penInput.surfaceManager
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: snip2texModelMenu
                anchors.fill: parent
                visible: false
                z: 1000

                property var menu: ({})
                property string status: ""
                property string out: ""
                property int polls: 0
                // the button's rect, in this item's coordinates
                property rect at: Qt.rect(0, 0, 0, 0)

                // not "log": Toolbar.qml has a LoggingCategory with id log, and ids win
                function snip2texLog(msg) {
                    console.log("[snip2tex] toolbar: " + msg);
                }

                function readFile(path) {
                    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    xhr.open("GET", "file://" + path, false);
                    try { xhr.send(); } catch (e) { return ""; }
                    return (xhr.responseText || "").trim();
                }

                // e-ink: tell xochitl's ghost buster, like stock dialogs do, so
                // the panel is repainted where the menu was
                function ghosting(open) {
                    let p = root;
                    while (p && p.ghostBuster === undefined) {
                        p = p.parent;
                    }
                    try {
                        if (p) {
                            p.ghostBuster.viewChange(open ? GhostBuster.DocumentViewDialogOpened
                                                          : GhostBuster.DocumentViewDialogClosed);
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        snip2texModelMenu.snip2texLog("ghostBuster: " + e);
                    }
                }

                function toggle(button) {
                    if (visible) {
                        close();
                        return;
                    }
                    const p = button.mapToItem(snip2texModelMenu, 0, 0);
                    at = Qt.rect(p.x, p.y, button.width, button.height);
                    const cached = readFile("/home/root/xovi/exthome/snip2tex/model.json");
                    try {
                        menu = cached ? JSON.parse(cached) : {};
                    } catch (e) {
                        menu = {};
                    }
                    visible = true;
                    ghosting(true);
                    run("");
                }

                function close() {
                    if (!visible) {
                        return;
                    }
                    visible = false;
                    ghosting(false);
                }

                function run(args) {
                    out = "/home/root/.snip2tex/model-" + Date.now() + ".json";
                    status = args ? "switching…" : "asking the Mac…";
                    polls = 0;
                    snip2texModelCmd.executeCommand("env", ["-u", "LD_PRELOAD", "sh", "-c",
                        "/home/root/xovi/exthome/snip2tex/model.sh " + out + " " + args + " >/dev/null 2>&1 &"]);
                    poll.restart();
                }

                function choose(id) {
                    if (id === menu.current) {
                        return;
                    }
                    snip2texModelMenu.snip2texLog("model " + id);
                    const m = Object.assign({}, menu);
                    m.current = id;
                    menu = m;
                    run("set " + id);
                }

                function toggleWifi() {
                    const on = !menu.prefer_wifi;
                    const m = Object.assign({}, menu);
                    m.prefer_wifi = on;
                    menu = m;
                    run("wifi " + (on ? "on" : "off"));
                    status = on ? "connecting over Wi-Fi (Tailscale)…" : "switching to USB…";
                }

                function toggleThinking() {
                    if (menu.thinking_locked) {
                        return;
                    }
                    const m = Object.assign({}, menu);
                    m.thinking = !menu.thinking;
                    menu = m;
                    run("thinking " + (m.thinking ? 1 : 0));
                }

                CommandExecutor {
                    id: snip2texModelCmd
                }

                Timer {
                    id: poll
                    interval: 300
                    repeat: true
                    onTriggered: {
                        const err = snip2texModelMenu.readFile(snip2texModelMenu.out + ".err");
                        if (err) {
                            snip2texModelMenu.status = err;
                            stop();
                            return;
                        }
                        const text = snip2texModelMenu.readFile(snip2texModelMenu.out);
                        if (text) {
                            try {
                                const m = JSON.parse(text);
                                snip2texModelMenu.menu = m;
                                snip2texModelMenu.status = m.note ? m.note
                                    : m.state === "loading" ? "loading the model on the Mac…"
                                    : m.state === "error" ? (m.error || "model error") : "";
                            } catch (e) {
                                snip2texModelMenu.status = "bad reply from the Mac";
                            }
                            stop();
                            return;
                        }
                        if (++snip2texModelMenu.polls > 200) {
                            snip2texModelMenu.status = "no answer from the Mac";
                            stop();
                        }
                    }
                }

                Connections {
                    target: root
                    function onExpandedChanged() {
                        snip2texModelMenu.close();
                    }
                }

                // a tap anywhere else closes the menu
                MouseArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    onClicked: snip2texModelMenu.close()
                }

                Rectangle {
                    id: card
                    width: 600
                    height: column.implicitHeight + 32
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 3
                    radius: 12
                    readonly property int gap: 12
                    x: {
                        const a = snip2texModelMenu.at;
                        let v = root.position === ToolbarPositioner.Position.Left ? a.x + a.width + gap
                              : root.position === ToolbarPositioner.Position.Right ? a.x - width - gap
                              : a.x + a.width - width;
                        return Math.max(16, Math.min(v, snip2texModelMenu.width - width - 16));
                    }
                    y: {
                        const a = snip2texModelMenu.at;
                        let v = root.position === ToolbarPositioner.Position.Bottom ? a.y - height - gap
                              : root.position === ToolbarPositioner.Position.Top ? a.y + a.height + gap
                              : a.y;
                        return Math.max(16, Math.min(v, snip2texModelMenu.height - height - 16));
                    }

                    // swallow taps on the card itself
                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                    }
                    PenInputBlocker {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        enabled: snip2texModelMenu.visible
                        manager: root.penInput.surfaceManager
                    }

                    Column {
                        id: column
                        x: 16
                        y: 16
                        width: parent.width - 32
                        spacing: 4

                        Text {
                            text: "AI model"
                            font.pixelSize: 26
                            font.bold: true
                            color: "#555555"
                            bottomPadding: 6
                        }

                        Repeater {
                            model: snip2texModelMenu.menu.options || []
                            delegate: Rectangle {
                                required property var modelData
                                width: column.width
                                height: 72
                                radius: 8
                                color: modelData.id === snip2texModelMenu.menu.current ? "black" : "white"
                                Text {
                                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                    x: 16
                                    width: parent.width - 32
                                    elide: Text.ElideRight
                                    text: modelData.label
                                    font.pixelSize: 30
                                    color: modelData.id === snip2texModelMenu.menu.current ? "white" : "black"
                                }
                                MouseArea {
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    onClicked: snip2texModelMenu.choose(modelData.id)
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        Rectangle {
                            width: column.width
                            height: 2
                            color: "#bbbbbb"
                            visible: (snip2texModelMenu.menu.options || []).length > 0
                        }

                        Rectangle {
                            width: column.width
                            height: 72
                            color: "white"
                            visible: (snip2texModelMenu.menu.options || []).length > 0
                            Text {
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                x: 16
                                text: snip2texModelMenu.menu.thinking_locked ? "Thinking: always on"
                                    : "Thinking: " + (snip2texModelMenu.menu.thinking ? "on" : "off")
                                font.pixelSize: 30
                                color: snip2texModelMenu.menu.thinking_locked ? "#777777" : "black"
                            }
                            Rectangle {
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                anchors.right: parent.right
                                anchors.rightMargin: 16
                                width: 84
                                height: 44
                                radius: 22
                                border.color: "black"
                                border.width: 3
                                color: snip2texModelMenu.menu.thinking ? "black" : "white"
                                opacity: snip2texModelMenu.menu.thinking_locked ? 0.4 : 1
                                Rectangle {
                                    width: 32
                                    height: 32
                                    radius: 16
                                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                    x: snip2texModelMenu.menu.thinking ? parent.width - width - 6 : 6
                                    color: snip2texModelMenu.menu.thinking ? "white" : "black"
                                }
                            }
                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onClicked: snip2texModelMenu.toggleThinking()
                            }
                        }

                        Rectangle {
                            width: column.width
                            height: 92
                            color: "white"
                            Column {
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                x: 16
                                Text {
                                    text: "Use Wi-Fi (Tailscale)"
                                    font.pixelSize: 30
                                    color: "black"
                                }
                                Text {
                                    text: snip2texModelMenu.menu.route === "wifi" ? "connected over Wi-Fi"
                                        : snip2texModelMenu.menu.route === "usb" ? "connected over USB" : ""
                                    font.pixelSize: 22
                                    color: "#555555"
                                }
                            }
                            Rectangle {
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                anchors.right: parent.right
                                anchors.rightMargin: 16
                                width: 84
                                height: 44
                                radius: 22
                                border.color: "black"
                                border.width: 3
                                color: snip2texModelMenu.menu.prefer_wifi ? "black" : "white"
                                Rectangle {
                                    width: 32
                                    height: 32
                                    radius: 16
                                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                    x: snip2texModelMenu.menu.prefer_wifi ? parent.width - width - 6 : 6
                                    color: snip2texModelMenu.menu.prefer_wifi ? "white" : "black"
                                }
                            }
                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onClicked: snip2texModelMenu.toggleWifi()
                            }
                        }

                        Text {
                            width: column.width
                            visible: text !== ""
                            text: snip2texModelMenu.status
                            wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                            font.pixelSize: 24
                            color: "#555555"
                            topPadding: 6
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
